official_sources.observed: Covered no-additional-charge distributable components may be distributed in machine-executable form including Bitstream, only to program Xilinx devices. Third-party licenses remain separate; separately licensed cores are outside that definition.
The 2024.1 unified-tool agreement has a corresponding compiled-component distribution provision and retains separate third-party terms. This is not a grant to relicense generated source as MIT.

Video Timing Controller 6.2 uses the Core License Agreement and the referenced guide says it needs no additional license. It should not be classified as a fee/evaluation core merely because it uses the Core License Agreement.

Allows covered material distribution in Bitstream form for a Xilinx device operating in the licensee's system-level hardware product, with original notices preserved. This is a product/target-limited grant, not a general open-source license for the core.
AXI DMA 7.1 is provided at no additional cost under the Xilinx End User License.
AXI VDMA 6.3 is provided at no additional cost under the Xilinx End User License.
AXI4-Stream to Video Out 4.0 is included at no additional cost under the End User License. The live guide has a later publication date than the saved implementation.
